scope: All 96 existing full-observation DQN development/confirmation traces and their 120000 saved training transitions. Previously scored confirmation cases are now visible diagnostic evidence, not a fresh confirmation set.
cycle_definition: A positional closed walk entirely at/after hazard onset; record last-visit interval and mark its member transitions. Time/FED observations still change, so this is not an identical full-state cycle.
reference: Finite-horizon clairvoyant optimal action values under the exact training objective, including the 2-FED-unit timeout penalty. Interpret action ranking/calibration only after the hazard has appeared and the configured field remains constant. Not an online competing policy.
comparisons: Predicted selected Q versus exact post-reveal optimal Q for that forced first action
Predicted selected Q versus saved greedy-policy suffix return (not the same reference as optimal Q)
Final-network one-step Bellman residual, not historical training loss/targets
All and final-replay-eligible training coverage, not actual minibatch sampling frequency

context_coverage.note: Declared descriptive neighborhood, not a universal coverage threshold or proof of an unseen observation. Report exact match, neighborhood and broad cell/action coverage separately.

representative: For each trace, first post-reveal cycle-member action with offline ranking regret greater than tolerance; otherwise first cycle-member action; otherwise first post-reveal step. No selection by largest error.
checks: Training archives and prior artifacts unchanged
Independent forward finite-horizon computation for every representative legal action
No historical target-network weights or sampled minibatch indices imputed
stop: Complete one cache-only audit and report evidence-based next decision. No optimizer, new rollouts, parameter search, model edits, LLM calls or old sealed final-bank reads.
